newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-RUGBY STAR BLANCO "TRIES" HIS HAND AT SOCCER - AND SCORES.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-RUGBY STAR BLANCO "TRIES" HIS HAND AT SOCCER - AND SCORES.

text.p: Former French international rugby full-back Serge Blanco tried his hand at soccer -- and scoring for a team of stars from France's 1984 European championship side.

Blanco, who now runs a hydrotherapy centre, came on as substitute to help Michel Platini's men to a 4-0 win over members of the Athletic Bilbao side that took consecutive Spanish league titles in 1983 and 1984.
Current Athletic manager Luis Fernandez, who was a member of France's winning team in 1984, was also one of the stars of Wednesday's game.
France won the European title 13 years ago beating Spain 2-0 in the final in Paris with goals from Platini, who scored in every round, and Bruno Bellone.
